## Weremantis Guard (Hybrid Form) (CR 4)

LE Medium humanoid (human, shapechanger)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 11, flat-footed 23 (+6 armor, +1 Dex, +7 natural)  
**hp** 54 (1d8+3d10+16)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +6; +1 vs. fear  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 10/silver  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** shortspear +7 (1d6+3), dagger +6 (1d4+3), or 2 claws +5 (1d6+3 plus grab)  
**Ranged** shortspear +5 (1d6+3), dagger +4 (1d4+3)  
**Special Attacks** channel positive energy 5/day (DC 12, 1d6), lunge, mandibles (+0 bite, 1d6+1 plus curse of lycanthropy; DC 15), sudden strike  
**Domain Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 1st; concentration +4)  


6/day—moment of insight, touch of evil  


**Cleric Spells Prepared** (CL 1st; concentration +4)  


1st—ant haul, detect undead, protection from good D  

0 (at will)—detect magic, detect poison, virtue  


**D** domain spell; **Domains** Destiny, Evil  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 13, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 17  
**Feats** Alertness, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness, Weapon Focus (shortspear)  
**Skills** Diplomacy +5, Heal +9, Intimidate +4, Knowledge (religion) +4, Sense Motive +9, Stealth +5 (+13 in forests), Survival +6; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+12 in forests)  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** change shape (human, hybrid, and giant mantis; polymorph), inhuman appearance, lycanthropic empathy (mantids and giant mantids)  


**Special Abilities**


**Destiny Domain Spell-Like Ability: Moment of Insight (Sp)** A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier you gain a +2 insight bonus to any attack roll, ability check, skill check, or saving throw.  

**Change Shape (Su)** Weremantids have three forms—a humanoid form, a giant mantis form, and a hybrid form. Equipment does not meld with the new form between humanoid and hybrid form, but does between those forms and giant mantis form.
